answer: Audits are published in zenith, queued in prism, and sparrow publishes the wait time. A farm of 225 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 87 identities per epoch. A farm of 1506 identities would post 3233 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
